QuestInfo.name: Stump's Weakness
QuestInfo.0: Power B. Fore, the instructor at the training center, claims to know the weakness of Stumps. You'd better go hear what he's got to say.
QuestInfo.1:
You acquired the Stump's Weakness skill. You should take advantage of the skill when hunting Stumps.

#o130100# #a24221#
QuestInfo.2: You used Stump's Weakness to effectively hunt Stumps.

0.0: Okay, now you have mastered the Stump's Weakness skill, right? Now let's use it to hunt some Stumps.\r\n#b#L0#How do I use this skill?#l\n#k
0.1: Ahh... Don't worry about things like that. That skill will be applied, regardless of what kind of attack you perform. Can you see how weak the Stumps are? How about you take out 40 Stumps?

no.0: If you don't want to do it, I have to say, it's your loss.

1.0: Okay, okay. Great work! You look like you can see and attack the weak points of the Stumps.\r\n#b#L0#Do other monsters have their weak points as well?#l\n#k
1.1: That is an excellent, excellent question! Monsters' weak points have yet to be revealed to everyone, but I do believe they will become known someday. I was able to find the weak points of these monsters, but I didn't train hard enough to make myself a famous adventurer. But I have a feeling you have the potential to achieve much more than that.

yes.0: Keep training. Don't stop until you become a famous adventurer!

mob.0: It doesn't look like you've taken out 40 Stumps yet.
